name: MOSE
description: A video object segmentation dataset focused on crowded and occluded scenes, comprising about 2,149 videos. Metadata only; no data is vendored.
citation: MOSE: A New Dataset for Video Object Segmentation in Complex Scenes. Ding et al., Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR), 2023.
